prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL high-end Japanese 2D fantasy RPG character sprite atlas. Transparent PNG; only the characters, no platforms, cast shadows, backgrounds, glow, particles, text, UI or panel divisions. A strictly aligned 3-column, 2-row grid with matching designs across the rows. The centers of cells are exactly x=16.7%, 50%, 83.3% and y=25%,75%; each tile must have 12% of its width and height completely empty as buffer on every side, poses stay inside their own cell. Top row composed as three confident graceful idle ready stances. Bottom row same characters and armor EXACTLY redrawn as three expressive attack poses, sword cut, bow drawn and aiming, staff thrust and palm casting respectively. All six in three-quarter FRONT view turned toward screen right, full body including all weapon tips and feet. Style is detailed collectible JRPG hero pixel art. Render deliberately hand-pixelled colors and contours, clean interlocking pixel clusters, hard edges, age 20+ faces, attractive and cool, about 2.9 heads tall, finely shaped hair, strong readable poses, proportionately small eyes, elegant diagonals and detailed layered costumes. A fine, selective warm rim light and colored shadows, jewel-toned costume colors against dark cool outlines. Neither soft painterly textures nor smooth high-res anime illustration. As if each original sprite was around 64 pixels tall enlarged nearest neighbor. Left hero: young adult swordsman with cascading swept-back burnished copper hair, elegant midnight-blue and silver layered armor accented with cream-gold embroidery, burgundy trailing cape including broad scarf knot and split into two ends. His broad one-handed silver blade has a blue and brass guard. Middle hero: slender adult woman forest ranger, lightly tanned, pale silvery long braided hair with a side fringe, deep emerald cape, asymmetrical teal layered jacket, muted cream sash, brown leggings and boots, beautiful recurved amber and pale birch bow with turquoise fittings. Right hero: young adult woman mage, long orchid hair fading to pale pink with crescent hair ornament, tapered off-center dark indigo witch hat with ochre underbrim, plum and lilac silk layered mantle, white tunic with gold trim, dark double cuff boots, golden crystal staff shaped like a lantern in geometric openwork. In bottom row action poses each character's head and feet stay approximately the same scale as idle pose and the same bottom alignment, avoid dramatically extended limbs and crossing cell bounds. Faces and wardrobe are especially polished at small scale. Craft a consistent distinctive visual family with compact pixels and a confident adventure tone.
